SELECT rs.store_id AS return_store, ss.store_id AS sale_store, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id LEFT JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (rs.store_id=900 OR ss.store_id=900 OR ss.store_id IS NULL)
GROUP BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) refunds_all_web, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN rs.store_id=900 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) refunds_at_web_store
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE ss.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
web_refunds AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period, w.sales_net - COALESCE(r.refunds_net, 0) AS net_sales, w.sales_net AS net_sales_before_returns
FROM web_sales w LEFT JOIN web_refunds r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY w.fiscal_period
